claim: § The Interface: "a learner who watches the wave reflect and lose its highs understands why a plucked string decays bright-to-dark in a way no decay-knob ever conveys"; § Why This Project Exists: the drawn string is the delay-line state, not a picture of it.

pieces.what: The Karplus-Strong sketch first (one delay line, one averaging filter), then the bidirectional study: pluck where you click and watch the two travelling waves sum, reflect and darken while you hear it
pieces.walks_up_from: one delay line holding a noise burst

pieces.what: The v1.12 seven-stop lesson (pluck, reflection, loss, pitch, stiffness, bow, body) run as video with its audio, so the 'understands' claim can be judged by a reader who cannot run the study
Stiffness tour and stretch-by-pitch chart side by side, testing that the dispersion allpass gives the stretched partials stiff strings have
The v1.8 body walk: bridge feeding the soundboard, heard with and without the body
